note: Pre-registration for the 0.36.0 credit snapshot (docs/47-credit-snapshot.md). Committed before any gallery, parser-check or held-out run. Nothing here names the gallery or held-out issuers: they are whatever these rules yield on Actions.
source: Latest Internet Archive capture (HTTP 200) of each SEC URL, fetched as original bytes (id_) and checked against the CDX SHA-1 digest. SEC answers this project's declared user agent with HTTP 403 from GitHub Actions and from the developer machine (probe run 43477784386, 2026-11-14), so no request goes to SEC. The HTML's own dei:EntityCentralIndexKey and dei:DocumentType must match the candidate.

dev_filings.note: Filings the definitions were developed on. Excluded from the held-out sample.

budget.per_filing_download_note: A gallery filing is fetched only when the visitor opens it, gzip-compressed; the gallery run reports each size

population.description: SEC Financial Statement Data Sets 2026q1, sub.txt: original 10-K filings of large accelerated filers with a December 31 fiscal year end and period 2025-12-31 (the population of XBRL 对照 rule b)

order.description: Within each stratum, ascending SHA-256 of salt + 10-digit zero-padded CIK

requires: Internet Archive capture of the primary document

gallery.note: Banks, insurers and investment companies are kept when the rule draws them: the page then shows that the template does not support them. Coverage is reported per stratum.

heldout_b.purpose: Check (b): an independent model computes the snapshot metrics from the filings under docs/47 before the program runs on them.
heldout_b.exclude: every CIK in the committed gallery (creditlens/snapshot/gallery.json at the time of the selection run) and the dev_filings CIKs

order.description: Ascending SHA-256 of salt + 10-digit zero-padded CIK, over the whole sample population (no strata)

heldout_b.accept: Same acceptance as the gallery. The selection run only selects and fetches; it does not run the snapshot program.

a_parser.reference: SEC Financial Statement Data Sets num.txt rows of the same accession (adsh), from the digest-checked Internet Archive capture of the quarter's zip. SEC CompanyFacts is the reference the brief asked for, but SEC refuses this project's user agent (run 43477784386); FSDS num.txt is SEC's own per-accession extract of the same XBRL submission. It covers the face financial statements only, not the notes.
a_parser.rows_compared: num.txt rows with empty segments and empty coreg (consolidated, no dimensions), every tag (standard and company extension)
a_parser.match_key: tag local name; uom (measure local names, divide as a/b); ddate (the context end date or instant rounded to the nearest month end, as FSDS does); qtrs (0 for instants, else round(days / 91.3125))
a_parser.value_rule: Exact decimal equality after the program's scale and sign. FSDS keeps at most 4 decimal places, so program values are rounded half-even to 4 places before comparing.
measures: recall: FSDS rows for which the program has at least one consolidated fact with the same key
agreement: of those rows, the share whose value equals one of the program's facts for the key
conflicts: rows found with no equal value

pass_bar.note: Every disagreement is listed with its class; the bar is judged on the first run and not re-tuned.

b_metrics.independent_model: Claude Sonnet (separate agent, not shown the program, its tests or its outputs), given only docs/47 section 'Definitions' and the filings' archive URLs
b_metrics.order: Sonnet's results are committed before the program runs on the held-out filings. The definitions freeze in a commit before Sonnet starts.
b_metrics.tolerance: Amounts: exact to the dollar. Ratios: absolute difference at most 0.005 after both are computed from their own amounts. Not-computed states must agree (both not computed, either reason).
b_metrics.report: First run with its commit: agreement per metric and per filing, and every disagreement assigned to one class: concept choice, period or context, table position, arithmetic, sign, scale, not-computed vs value, independent reader error. No pass bar; the classes are the result.

c_highlights.where: GitHub Actions, Playwright Chromium 1.49.1, on the built site, every committed gallery filing
c_highlights.test: Click every figure link the snapshot shows. The click must mark exactly one element in the sandboxed filing view; that element must be the fact's anchor, inside the frame's viewport, and its text parsed by the fact's ixt format, times 10^scale, negated when sign is '-', must equal the displayed value (which is also parsed from the visible text with its stated unit).
c_highlights.pass_bar: 100% of clicks. Figures whose fact has no visible cell (ix:hidden without a -sec-ix-hidden display) are not links and are counted separately.
